push.title: L 4-6 vs FcCHI400s | You: 9.0
push.body:
buddskees, you put up a 9.0. That's the kind of number a coach writes down in pen.

THE GOOD
+ A hat trick against FcCHI400s. The net said thank you, and so do I.
+ Most tackles attempted you've had in 15 matches for us (5). Write that one down and stick it on the fridge.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. If the rest of the night was a storm, that was the lighthouse.
+ Fewest misplaced passes on the team (3). That's what showing up looks like.

THE BAD
- Missed tackles 3, up from your usual 1. That's on the to-do list now.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. It's a small thing until it's the whole thing.
- A promotion match, and we lost it. I'm not pointing fingers. I'm pointing at the mirror, mine included.
- In our wins you average 4 giveaways; here it was 6. Honest truth: that cost us.
- 6 goals conceded: -0.2. Attention to detail fixes this.

Tonight's homework: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.

One thought for the road, buddskees: A goal is just a pass to the net.

Proud of you. Now go drink some water. - Coach Lasso

BellyTb1, a 7.0. You've got more in the tank, and we're gonna go find it together.

THE GOOD
+ 2 key passes. Somebody's gonna owe you dinner for those passes.
+ You and buddskees were on the same wavelength, like two radios tuned to the good station.
+ Tackles attempted 3, up from your usual 1. That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.

- A promotion match, and we lost it. Nobody carries that alone. We carry it as a team.
- Lowest tackles attempted on the team: 3 (best was buddskees's 5). Start here: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
- 6 goals conceded cost 0.2. Squeaky wheel; let's oil it.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 46%, down from your usual 76%. That's not football. That's spectating in boots. Focus point: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.

Five minutes of this: Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy.

Remember, BellyTb1: Be curious about your game, not cruel to it.

Never mind the noise; mind the next rep. - Coach Lasso
